title: Package the reusable newsroom pod
description:
# Package the reusable newsroom pod

## Intent

As an internal publication operator, I want a repeatable newsroom pod template built from demonstrated needs, so that a new pre-infrastructure publication can start without reconstructing the Anth.us experiment.

## Entry criteria

- Two real publications have completed the workflow.
- The repeated configuration, doctrine boundaries, hooks, and handoff needs are known.

## Definition of Done

- A version-pinned pod template establishes the newsroom workflow, policies, per-story file convention, minimal doctrine, and agent skill.
- Publication-specific doctrine and CMS adapters remain outside the generic template.
- Setup and upgrade expectations are documented and tested from a clean environment.
- Every generalized feature is supported by evidence from more than one publication.
- Proposed Kanbus-core work is separately reviewed and tracked on the Kanbus board; newsroom-only behavior stays in configuration or hooks.

## Non-goals

- A new pod binary or storage layer.
- Hosted Papyrus parity.
- External funnel claims.
